key_insight: A proximal policy optimization agent can search quantum circuits for approximate state preparation while jointly optimizing fidelity and gate count.
engineering_relevance: This provides a scalable automated strategy for quantum circuit synthesis, useful for reducing manual design effort as qubit counts and search spaces grow.
method: Use deep reinforcement learning with PPO as the circuit-construction policy.
Append one quantum gate at each step and recompute fidelity to the target state.
Balance state-preparation accuracy against circuit length to find compact approximations.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on 2 to 5 qubits across Bell, GHZ, W, Dicke, and random target states report approximation errors as low as 10^-14.
watch_item: Results are shown on small qubit counts, so performance and training stability may change substantially as the state space scales up.
paper_title: Approximate Quantum State Preparation Through Proximal Policy Optimization
